notes.title: Demo Launch And Live Playthrough
notes.content:
[h2]As part of the Steam Next Fest! Tiny Planet Protectors will be releasing a public demo June 16th[/h2]
I will be livestreaming gameplay of myself again playing the new public demo of Tiny Planet Protectors [b]June 16th at 5pm pst![/b]

[previewyoutube=QkV6uqXHTw4;full][/previewyoutube]

Would love to see some of you there and hope you check out the demo yourself!

- Cole

https://discord.gg/mXMgGSc

notes.title: Beta Testing Sign Up Now Available!
notes.content:
Attention Agents 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305035/b4c89f086c4445179edd3a113c23592c0e79281a.gif[/img]

The official website for Tiny Planet Protectors is now live:
https://www.colechittim.com/tinyplanet
So you can view all the gifs and screenshots in all their glory.

But more importantly,
[h3]you may now sign up to be part of the upcoming Tiny Planet Protectors early access group![/h3]
This group will have limited time access to the upcoming Demo in late May to provide feedback and improve the experience before it launches publicly shortly after.

If you are interested in assisting the TPPA by providing feedback to polish the experience,
please visit the form below to declare your interest

https://forms.gle/LDfHt3HTs1MsKgGs9

If you are eligible and selected you will be notified within the next few weeks.

[b]Do note, in order to participate in the early access you must be a member of our discord in order to communicate[/b]

You can join the official discord here:
https://discord.gg/mXMgGSc
